description:
A simple program to monitor your network/data usage. Made for the average windows user.

OpenNetMeter monitors your network speed and data usage. It shows the current session's usage, the data usage for today, and detailed usage for any period up to the past 60 days. A mini widget can be placed over the taskbar to display the network speed.
main changes since v0.15.0
What's new
- Record traffic: use Record / Stop in the Active Processes header to capture per-process usage between two points in time. Stopping shows a results window you can export (#44)
- Export your usage history as CSV, JSON or a self-contained HTML report. History exports the selected profile and date range, and Settings exports everything (#119)
- Configurable history retention: 60 days (default), 180 days, 1 year or Forever (#119)
- Smarter network adapter choice: OpenNetMeter now follows the adapter Windows actually routes internet traffic through, so full-tunnel VPNs (WireGuard and similar) are counted per app. It re-checks when routes change, and you can also pin a specific adapter in Settings (#15)
- The mini widget's total can now show usage since a date you choose, not just the current session (#125)
- History shows which profile and time the results were last filtered for
- The status bar dot shows whether a network adapter is active
Fixes
- Only one copy of OpenNetMeter runs at a time. Opening it again brings up the running window instead of starting a second capture (#117)
- Starting minimized (/StartMinimized) now really starts in the tray
- The installer now installs the 64-bit app to Program Files instead of Program Files (x86). Upgrading removes the old install and keeps your history and settings
- Start with Windows keeps working after upgrading from an older version
- Usage From and Weekly Trend no longer drop to zero while disconnected; they keep showing the last network's usage
- Usage From can be set to today after midnight without restarting the app
- Each Wi-Fi adapter now shows its own network name, and network names no longer depend on the Windows display language
- Network profiles in History now reload correctly when the network changes
- Delete All now reliably removes the database file
- Faster history cleanup on large databases
- Updated vulnerable third-party dependencies
Improvements
- The Settings page is reorganised into four cards: General, Mini widget, Network monitoring, and History & data
- Dialogs work better from the keyboard: focus moves into them, Tab stays inside, and Esc cancels
- Upgraded to .NET 10
- Updated the privacy policy to cover history retention, data export and the update check
This installer may trigger a Windows security warning because it is not code-signed. This is not a sign of malware. I do not currently have a code-signing certificate, and those cost money. If you downloaded this from the official OpenNetMeter GitHub release page, it is safe to continue.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Ashfaaq18/OpenNetMeter/compare/v0.15.0...v0.16.0
